description:
Meet China's "new new three" exports: robots, AI and innovative medicines.
Following the "old three" consumer goods and the "new three" green technologies, these frontier innovations are now reaching global markets, and supporting smarter industries, better healthcare and new solutions to shared challenges.
Same number. But an entirely new chapter. 
#Robotics #AI #Biotech#Innovation #GlobalCooperation

author: New China TV
description:
Huangyan Dao has become a flashpoint in the #SouthChinaSea, with the #Philippines seeking to claim the island for itself through unilateral arbitrations, military confrontations and more.

How did the #dispute reach this point? And what role has #Washington played? Reporting from the waters off #HuangyanDao, we put these questions to leading experts and examine the #history, #law and #geopolitics behind the dispute.

A Miao Xiaojuan Studio Film
A Xinhua News Agency Production
title: From Huangyan Dao: Examining a South China Sea Flashpoint

author: New China TV
description:

At Dunhuang Press, visitors can collect 300 free stamps featuring the city's cultural icons -- from flying apsaras to desert landscapes and Silk Road landmarks. #TrendyChina
title: Trendy China | Discover Dunhuang, one stamp at a time

author: New China TV
description: A China-developed meteorological early warning system is helping to improve weather forecasting and disaster preparedness in Ethiopia. Now operated by local experts, the platform combines satellite observations, AI and local data to deliver faster, more accurate warnings for hazards such as droughts and flash floods. #GLOBALink
title: China's AI-powered MAZU platform boosts Ethiopia's forecasting capacity

#Drone #Innovation #Bamboo #ChinaTech #Aviation #FutureTech #LowAltitudeEconomy

description: Looking to beat the tropical heat? In China's southernmost island province of #Hainan, one dessert tops the list: qingbuliang.
